entities.text: Vigneshyadav And 2 Others vs The State Of Telangana
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
1
 The Honourable Sri Justice E.V. Venugopal
 Criminal Petition No.1795 Of 2021
O R D E R:

This Criminal Petition is filed by the petitioners seeking to quash the proceedings against them in C.C.No.227 of 2019 pending before the learned XXII Metropolitan Magistrate, Ibrahimpatnam, at Rachakonda (for short, "the trial Court") for the offences punishable under Sections 120-B, 420 and 506 r/w 34 of I.P.C. and Section 156(3) of Cr.P.C.
2.

entities.text: XXII Metropolitan Magistrate, Ibrahimpatnam, at Rachakonda
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Heard Mr.A.Ushi Reddy, learned counsel for the petitioners, Mr.E.Ganesh, learned Assistant Public Prosecutor appearing for respondent Nos.1 and 2 and Mr.Avancha H Chakravarthy, learned counsel for respondent Nos.3 to 5.
3.

Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that respondent Nos.3 to 5 filed the civil suit vide O.S.No.351 of 2019 seeking the relief of Specific Performance of agreement of sale dated 09.04.2016 against the petitioners herein and others and the respondent-Police have converted the matter of civil nature into criminal proceedings and falsely implicated the petitioners in the present crime.

Therefore, relying on the decision passed by the Hon'ble Supreme Court in A.H.Mohan Vs. The State represented by SHO and another 1, he seeks to allow this Criminal Petition.
4.
Opposing the same, learned counsel for unofficial respondent Nos.3 to 4 submits that the matter requires to be tried.
Therefore, he seeks to dismiss this Criminal Petition.

5. Having regard to the submissions of both the learned counsel and upon perusal of the material available on record, this Court is of the view that the matter requires adjudication at length and only upon conclusion of a full-fledged trial, the truth would come to light.
Therefore, this Court is not inclined to entertain the Criminal Petition.
6. Accordingly, this Criminal Petition is dismissed.

However, as sought by the learned counsel for the petitioners, the appearance of the petitioners in C.C.No.227 of 2019 on the file of the learned XXII Metropolitan Magistrate, Ibrahimpatnam, at Rachakonda is dispensed with on each and every adjournment unless and until specifically required by the trial Court.
If the petitioners fail to appear before the trial Court as on the date specified, this order dispensing with their appearance stands vacated automatically.
Law Finder Doc Id # 2524814 Miscellaneous Petitions, pending if any, shall stand closed.
